title: Optimizer Race: bbob in 2-D

calls.amm: amm_optimizer.minimize(f, x0, budget, rng, config=presets.get('c46'), bounds=(-5, 5)); points clipped to the box with penalty |x - clip(x)|^2
calls.slsqp: scipy.optimize.minimize(f, x0, method='SLSQP', bounds=[(-5, 5)] * 2, options={'maxiter': budget, 'ftol': 1e-14}), restarted
calls.nelder_mead: scipy.optimize.minimize(f, x0, method='Nelder-Mead', options={'maxfev': budget, 'xatol': 1e-10, 'fatol': 1e-10}), restarted
calls.cma_bipop: cma.fmin2(f, start, 2.0, {maxfevals: budget, bounds: [-5, 5], seed}, restarts=9, bipop=True)
calls.hcma: COCO data archive 2013/HCMA_loshchilov_noiseless (Loshchilov 2013), run of instance k; logged samples only

seeds: race (f, k): bbob instance k; SeedSequence([0x41544D, k, f, 2, k]) split into start points and optimizer stream, as in the FT1 harness
